nodes.reading:
Swiss non-profit association UID/IDE: CHE-481.709.475 MSA – 41A route des Jeunes 1227 Carouge, Geneva Switzerland

Tegrity.AI is not a separate legal person. It is the applied research, engineering and pre-standardization initiative through which the Society operates this website.

This policy applies to personal data processed through Tegrity.AI, direct communications sent to the addresses published on this website, and related research or institutional enquiries handled by the Tegrity.AI Circle.

Processing is governed principally by the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP). The EU/EEA General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable laws may also apply depending on the person, activity and place of processing. A more specific notice or agreement will take precedence for a particular pilot, evaluation, contribution or event.

We ask that you do not send sensitive personal data unless it is necessary and an appropriate channel and purpose have been agreed in advance.

nodes.title: Field Notes
nodes.reading:
Four research paths to measure avoidable suffering, test the limits of agentic systems and compare whether chosen solidarity can solve problems that competition, orders or negotiation cannot.

Cuatro vías de investigación para medir sufrimiento evitable, poner a prueba los límites de los sistemas agénticos y comparar si la solidaridad elegida puede resolver problemas que la competencia, la orden o la negociación no resuelven.

A concise guide to the paper’s central argument, how individually sound controls can fail together, and the role of the technical annexes.

A guide for readers and collaborators to review, challenge and contribute to the technical work.

An appendix linking the claims of the paper to the supporting evidence and the bounds of that evidence.
